description:
Swimming Pool Tiles 001 are turquoise swimming pool tiles for lining the walls and floor of a pool, the choice to make if you want the bright, clear-water look shown in the product photo.

## How they look
The photo is a finished pool scene: the water reads as a clean turquoise because of the colour of the tiles under it. Light blue pool tiles like these tend to look brighter in strong sun and a little deeper in shade or in the evening, so judge the shade outdoors rather than on a screen.

## Where they work
- **Home swimming pool tiles** for a family pool or a farmhouse pool where a fresh, holiday look matters.
- **Pool lining tiles** for walls and floor in one shade, with a border or a darker step marker added if you want contrast.
- **Plunge pools and splash pools**, where one colour keeps a small pool simple.

A pale lining tends to show the depth clearly and makes leaves or dirt easy to spot, which helps with cleaning.

## Good to know
- Category: swimming pool tiles
- Look: turquoise lining (from a pool scene photo)
- Size, thickness and finish are not listed online yet; the sales team will confirm them with your quote.

Pools are a wet, chemical-treated area, so ask your contractor about waterproofing, a pool-grade adhesive and grout, and keep all tiles from one batch so the shade stays even.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715), hold it in sunlight, and send your pool size and city for a dated quote. Pair it with [blue and white border tiles](/products/swimming-pool-border-tiles) or browse the full [swimming pool tiles range](/categories/swimming-pool-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of turquoise pool tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the pattern, the area to cover and delivery, so send your pool measurements and city on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Why do turquoise tiles make pool water look clear?
faqs.a: Water picks up the colour of the surface under it. A light turquoise lining reflects more light than a dark one, so the water tends to look brighter and the floor stays visible.

faqs.q: Turquoise or dark blue pool tiles: which is better?
faqs.a: Turquoise gives a bright, tropical look and shows dirt clearly for cleaning; dark blue gives a deeper, lake-like look and hides small marks. It comes down to the style you want and how much shade the pool gets.

faqs.q: How do I get a sample?
faqs.a: Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with the product name and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
